The Raven

[[File:Map.svg|thumb|Map of the locations in the [[Zelda clone]]]]
[[Category:Nine gods]]
[[sn:The Raven]]The Raven, with its shimmering black plumage and watchful eyes, is an enigmatic spirit that pervades the narratives of the Gwaiian Expanse. It's a creature that embodies wit, transformation, and the essential bridge between the world of the spirits and that of humans. Guiding players through the Totem Library, The Raven becomes the touchstone, ensuring the lore and legacy of the Gwaiian ancestors remain luminous and unaltered.

== Biography ==
Born from the spirit of the Haida Gwaii archipelago and nourished by the tales of ancient seers, The Raven played a pivotal role in shaping the Totem Library. As an emblem of wisdom, it has been a guardian of stories, ensuring that the ancestral tales remain pure and untouched by external distortions.

== Attributes ==
*** Ethereal Flight: The Raven's flight is more than just movement; it's an ethereal dance that can alter the reality of its surroundings.
*** Mesmerizing Caw: Its haunting call can echo memories of bygone eras, immersing players into the depths of Gwaiian tales.
*** Shape-shifting Abilities: Representing its transformative nature, The Raven can morph into different entities, aiding players in diverse situations.

== Role in the Totem Library ==
As the guardian spirit, The Raven plays the dual role of protector and guide. While ensuring the sanctity of the Library's tales, it also imparts wisdom and direction to the adventurers, helping them discern truth from the Absurdist's illusions.

== Teachings ==
*** Valuing and preserving ancestral narratives as treasures.
*** Embracing change while staying rooted in one's heritage.
*** Recognizing the harmony and balance between humans, spirits, and nature.

== Blessings ==
To those who respect the Gwaiian heritage and engage earnestly with the stories, The Raven grants:
*** Ancestral Sight: A vision that allows players to see spirits and interact with them.
*** Guided Path: A subtle nudge towards the right direction when puzzles or adversities seem insurmountable.
*** Song of Echoes: A tune that can unveil hidden narratives or grant protection from malevolent entities.

== Legacy ==
In the vast expanse of the Totem Library, The Raven stands tall as a sentinel of stories, a beacon of wisdom, and a symbol of the cyclical nature of life. Its presence challenges players to understand the importance of narratives, urging them to carry the lessons learned in the library to their own worlds, fostering respect and understanding for diverse cultures and their legacies.

For those who traverse the Gwaiian Expanse, The Raven isn't just a guardian spirit – it's a testament to the power of stories, the beauty of legacy, and the everlasting dance of transformation.
